gaps.sentence: I'll be there ___ ten minutes at the latest.
gaps.explanation: 'in ten minutes' = after ten minutes have passed.

gaps.sentence: I'm in no ___ — take your time deciding.
The museum is open to the public ___ appointment only.
He acted on his own ___ and did not ask permission.
gaps.hint: on your own ___ = without being told
gaps.explanation: 'On one's own initiative' = deciding and acting independently.

gaps.sentence: She succeeded in ___ of repeated setbacks.
The surgeons operated ___ the light of head-torches when the power failed.
gaps.explanation: 'By the light of' = using the light from something.

gaps.sentence: He completed the marathon despite being ___ breath.
gaps.explanation: 'out of breath' = breathing fast from effort.

gaps.sentence: The original manuscript is ___ permanent display in Vienna.
gaps.explanation: 'on display' = being shown to the public.
